description:
Load the US macroeconomic dataset and create a dual-axis visualization comparing real GDP growth and inflation.

1. The dataset 'usa.gdt' is loaded. It contains 'gdp' (Real GDP) and 'inf' (Inflation).
2. Create a new variable named 'g_gdp' representing the annualized quarterly growth rate of Real GDP using the formula: 400 * diff(log(gdp)). (Use Add > Define new variable or the console).
3. Create a Time Series plot containing both 'g_gdp' and 'inf'.
4. Configure the plot to use Dual Y-Axes: put 'g_gdp' on the Left Axis and 'inf' on the Right Axis.
5. Save the plot as a PNG image to '/home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/growth_inflation_plot.png'.
6. Save the plot as a Gnuplot script to '/home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/growth_inflation_plot.plt' (in the graph window, use the Save icon > Save to file > Gnuplot script).
